mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members (username, password, name, nickname, email, grade) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{grade})
mapper.select: SELECT username, name, nickname, email, profile_image_path AS profileImagePath, grade, bio FROM members WHERE username = #{username} AND password = #{password} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET grade = #{grade}, nickname = #{nickname}, profile_image_path = #{profileImagePath}, bio = #{bio} WHERE username = #{username};
